# netcup_server_disk (Data Source)

One disk of a netcup server (SCP REST API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_server_disk" "example" {
  server_id = 12345
  name      = "vda"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the disk, e.g. `vda`.
- `server_id` (Number) Id of the server.

### Read-Only

- `allocation_in_mib` (Number) Allocated size in MiB.
- `capacity_in_mib` (Number) Capacity in MiB.
- `storage_driver` (String) Storage driver of the disk.
